description: This file implements a React component for a Next.js page named 'DocumentUploadPage'. It provides a user interface for uploading three required documents (Resume, Performance Review, and Job Description), manages their state, handles file uploads to backend endpoints, polls for build status, and navigates the user upon completion. It contains client-side logic, UI components, and API interaction code.

methods.name: getBackendBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for the backend API, preferring environment variable NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL or defaulting to localhost.

methods.name: assertOk
methods.description: Checks the fetch response for success; throws an error with details if the response is not ok.

methods.name: handleGenerate
methods.description: Main handler function triggered when user initiates persona generation; uploads files, starts orchestration, polls status, and navigates upon success.

methods.name: pollBuildStatus
methods.description: Polls the backend for build status updates until completion or timeout.

methods.name: uploadCategorizedDocuments
methods.description: Handles uploading the three categorized documents to the backend, with category metadata.
